title: Kanban board
description: Work board with columns you manage on the page, labels, priorities, due dates, checklists, images, comments, and an agent hand-off flow.

fields.label: Starting columns
fields.help: Only used to create the first columns. Afterwards you add, rename and reorder columns on the page.

options.label: Development: Backlog, Ready, In progress, Review, Done
Agent: Inbox, Ready for agent, Agent working, Needs review, Done

fields.label: Agent hand-off
fields.help: Agent inbox and review columns, agent status on cards, and signals an agent can wait on.

agentActions.label: Triage inbox
agentActions.description: Label, prioritise and tidy new cards

agentActions.label: Triage this card
agentActions.description: Label, prioritise and tidy one card
agentActions.prompt: Triage card {{card}} on the board {{page.title}} ({{page.key}}): add labels and a priority, tidy its title and description, and comment with questions if it is unclear. Don't move it into an agent column or start work on it.

agentActions.label: Break this card down
agentActions.description: Turn the card into checklist steps
agentActions.prompt: Break down card {{card}} on the board {{page.title}} ({{page.key}}): read it and write its checklist as small, concrete steps. If it is really several pieces of work, say so in a comment and suggest the cards to split it into. Don't move it or start work on it.
